name: Youth Employment Partnership (YEP) summer and afterschool jobs
what_you_do: You can get paid job training and work placements in Oakland, including summer programs (Oakland Summer Rising, Team Oakland, Career Try-Out) and afterschool jobs.
who_can_apply: Oakland youth. YEP's job training serves ages 14 to 24. The City of Oakland's summer list shows YEP's summer program for ages 14 to 18.
pay_detail: Paid; about 100 hours of work in the City summer program (hourly rate not posted)
duration: Summer: about 100 hours, June 1 to Sept 30 (City list). Afterschool jobs during the school year.
deadline_text: No closing dates posted. YEP lists an Afterschool Job Application and a Young Adult Program Application 2026.
how_to_apply: Use the application links on yep.org/how-you-join, or call 510-533-3447 or visit 2300 International Blvd, Oakland.
notes: The YEP page does not give pay rates. Age 14 to 18 for summer comes from the City of Oakland table; the 19 to 24 programs are for older youth.
